description: Search for weather observation stations by location, bounding box, dataset, and data type. Returns station IDs, names, coordinates, elevation, and data coverage dates. Filter by locationId (e.g., "FIPS:37" for all NC stations), extent (lat/lon bounding box), datasetId, datatypeId, and date range. Station IDs returned here are used as stationId in noaa_climate_fetch_data. A station must have data for the dataset and date range you want — filter by datasetId and startDate/endDate to ensure compatibility. Common station ID formats: GHCND:USW00024233, COOP:010008.

datacategoryId.description: Filter to stations with data in this category (e.g., "TEMP"). Optional.

datasetId.description: Filter to stations that have data in this dataset (e.g., "GHCND" for daily observations). Optional.

datatypeId.description: Filter to stations that record these data types (e.g., ["TMAX", "TMIN", "PRCP"]). Optional.

endDate.description: Filter to stations with data on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

extent.description: Bounding box as "minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon": four finite signed decimal or scientific numbers with optional surrounding whitespace, latitude ±90 and longitude ±180. Equal coordinates are accepted; reversed axes return no matches, without wrapping. Example: "47.5,-122.4,47.7,-122.1". Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25. Larger positive integers are clamped to 1000 with a notice unless NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS=false.

locationId.description: Filter to stations within this location ID (e.g., "FIPS:37" for NC, "CITY:US530018" for Seattle). Obtain from noaa_climate_find_locations. Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return for pagination. Defaults to 0.

sortField.description: Sort results by this field. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Optional; defaults to asc.

startDate.description: Filter to stations with data on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

name: noaa_climate_find_stations

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. `validation_error`: startDate is after endDate, or a filter parameter is not recognized by NOAA CDO (e.g., unknown locationId or datacategoryId). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when the requested offset is past the end of a non-empty result set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

metadata.description: Pagination metadata. Present when the API returns it.

resultset.description: Pagination cursor fields for this response.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

offset.description: Zero-based starting index of this page, echoing the requested offset.

notice.description: Page-limit adjustment and empty or exhausted-page guidance. Omitted when no guidance applies.

datacoverage.description: Fractional data coverage (0–1). Omitted when not provided.

elevation.description: Station elevation. Unit depends on elevationUnit. Omitted when not provided.

elevationUnit.description: Unit for elevation (e.g., "Meters"). Omitted when not provided.

latitude.description: Station latitude in decimal degrees. Omitted when not provided.

longitude.description: Station longitude in decimal degrees. Omitted when not provided.

maxdate.description: Latest date data is available at this station. Omitted when not provided.

mindate.description: Earliest date data is available at this station. Omitted when not provided.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching stations before the page limit.

title: Find NOAA Climate Stations
